candidates.title: Seven arrested for Nagole murder of cab driver, four absconding
Six teenagers drown during Ganesh idol immersion in Sangareddy
candidates.excerpt: Six students of a charitable trust drowned during Ganesh idol immersion at Neruducherla lake in Sangareddy’s Pedda Kanjerla village. Nine students entered the water, but three managed to swim back to safety. Police retrieved the bodies and registered a case.

candidates.title: Belagavi: Fire accident toll rises to six
Man jumps into NSP canal, wife dies by suicide in Khammam
candidates.excerpt: A man jumped into the NSP canal in Khammam in an alleged suicide attempt, while his wife died by suicide at their home in separate incidents. Police launched a search with NDRF assistance, while their two school-going children were left grieving.
